about: Phase I, I.7: each studio page's frame and memory budget, held by tools/budgets.py in build-app.yml's studio job. A repaint is the whole 1920x1080 window in software Skia, timed 30 times once the page has settled; the heap is after a collection. Set at about twice what CI measured on 2026-10-12 (builder 263 ms, duel 58, present 72, world 5 — world held at twice the 57 ms a desk measured, since CI's reading is far below it; heaps 43-59 MB); raise one only with a reason in the commit.
